sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-Base-BF16 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is intended for developers and researchers building LLMs. As the base checkpoint of the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning family, it is the recommended starting point for pre-training research, continued pre-training on domain corpora, and building custom post-trained variants (SFT, RL, and distillation) via NeMo RL, NeMo Gym, and Megatron-LM.
